title: owo-lib issue #480: [26.1] Crash when another mod attempts to access the args on a TranslatableContents
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (MIT) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by MoriyaShiine]
This notably happens when Enchancement is installed (see https://github.com/MoriyaShiine/enchancement/issues/300), but this will happen with any other mod as well if they mixin into TranslatableContents and attempt to modify or access the `args` field (this might even crash without mixins by just calling `getArgs()`? I'm unsure if you set the args later but regardless :p).

Reproducible simply by launching the game lol

Something as simple as [this](https://github.com/MoriyaShiine/enchancement/blob/main/src/main/java/moriyashiine/enchancement/mixin/enchantment/buoy/client/TranslatableContentsMixin.java) causes a problem
